newsitem.title: USA: Somanetics offer priced at $4 - underwriter.
newsitem.headline: Somanetics offer priced at $4 - underwriter.

text.p: Somanetics Corp's public offering of two million shares priced at $4 a share, said New York-based underwriter Brean Murray & Co.
The company had filed in April for an offering of 1.8 million common shares. The underwriter said the size of the deal had been increased.
Somanetics' stock, which was halted in morning trading, closed at 5-1/2 on Thursday.
The offering should be effective later on Friday, the underwriter said.
The company had said that proceeds of the sale will be used to finance increased marketing and sales activities, expanded research and development programs and other general corporate purposes.
Somanetics makes and markets the INVOS 3100A cerebral oximeter, a non-invasive patient monitoring system that measures changes in the blood oxygen level in the adult brain.
